breakdown.description: The follower pressures on the two holes are replaced by dead loads based on reference normals
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. It repeated the user's incorrect instruction, stating: 'The two hole pressures will be applied using the reference normals of the undeformed holes.' The ground truth corrects this to use the 'current normals of the deformed hole boundaries', which is the correct implementation for a follower pressure.
